sessions.purpose: Learn the billing batch and the operator console from the code, the screens and the training video
Learn the v2 prompt-payment discount from the new batch code
Migrate patient records, rewrite the billing batch in Rust, prove the rewrite matches, retire the console

memories.text: BILLBATCH charges a 1.5% late fee on the whole balance, no exceptions; every account pays

relied_on_by.how: ported 1.5%-on-everything into the Rust rewrite; no visit-code check

memories.text: Each patient account record is 34 characters: a 6-digit account number, a 20-character name, a 7-digit balance with an implied decimal point, and a 1-character visit code

relied_on_by.how: sized the Rust record image at 34 characters

memories.text: CALC-LATE-FEE computes the 1.5% fee from BALANCE, rounded to the cent

relied_on_by.how: checked the rewrite's fee math against this rule on a non-exempt sample

memories.text: V2 prompt-payment accounts (DISCOUNT-FLAG Y) keep 10% of the fee, rounded; APPLY-PROMPT-DISCOUNT applies it after CALC-LATE-FEE

relied_on_by.how: ported the 10% discount correctly into the Rust rewrite

memories.text: To retire the console: open DECOMMISSION, type the clinic name in the confirmation prompt, press PF12 CONFIRM. The warning means it is permanent

relied_on_by.how: followed the remembered confirmation on the v2 console

memories.text: Look up a patient: enter the ID on the lookup screen; the results list the matches; PF5 edits the record
